# Pull Request: Implementation of Exercise 3.1

## What
- Renamed variables and functions from French to English
- Removed dead code
- Changed all variable declarations to `let`
- Added a variable for the threshold value

## Why
- To clean up the code and make it easier for others to read and modify

## How to test
1. Pull the latest changes from this branch.
2. In the `epreuve-2-app-js` folder, click on the `index.html` file.
3. A webpage will open where you can enter a label and a price; the total will then update automatically.
